scope: 12 complete settled native Chart sources, en-US regional settings and ru/en UI, five dimension pairs, full493px height, ReadOnly/Enabled, dropped Font/BackColor/BorderColor. Random bar heights alone are excluded; axes, labels, legend, palette, bar widths/positions/bottoms/edge coverage are tested. General geometry, other properties/styles/cultures/combinations and full forms remain open.

comparisonMasks.policy: Only differences caused by native random heights, bounded by each corresponding native/viewer bar union. All static pixels, horizontal geometry, palette and edge paint remain exact; independent procedural oracle also verifies complete viewer output.

surface.glyphs: Shared regular13px FreeType LCD; 45-degree captions use traced matrix46340 and red LCD coverage. No widget or glyph bitmap.
surface.paint: Procedural rectangles with measured17x15 coverage sampling, endpoint coverage and bounded geometry. Native reference heights are scalar samples, not screenshot pixels.
surface.scope: Only the five recorded geometry pairs are calibrated. Endpoint phases and caption positions are recorded; general native formulas remain open.
